She called me selfish and ungrateful—words she’s used before—and even though part of me knows she says things in anger, it still stings. I stormed out and now I’m sitting here shaking, torn between wanting to cry and wanting to scream. Why does it always have to be like this?

But there’s this voice in my head that’s been there for years, agreeing with her, telling me I’m flawed in some fundamental way. It’s exhausting to keep fighting that voice, especially when the person who’s supposed to love me keeps reinforcing it.

And it’s not just my mom—it’s like every time someone dismisses me or gets impatient, that kid feels abandoned all over again. I just want to feel like I matter, you know? Like I’m not some burden or disappointment. But I don’t even know how to start believing that about myself.
